subject: DPA + SCC route proposal & security questionnaire kickoff - MediStream
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Sato <laura.sato@medistream.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps: DPA preference / SCC module / security SQ kickoff

Hi Laura —

Great to meet today — thanks for the run-through of MediStream's platform and compliance constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum with procurement: 

Key points from the call:
- You confirmed MediStream will act as the Controller for patient enrichment pipelines; Redwood would be Processing certain telemetry and inference outputs.
- SOC 2: you have a Type II report in progress, expected Q4; you shared a one-page SOC2 summary we can review.
- HIPAA: in-scope for our engagement (BAA required).

My recommendations / asks: 
1) SCC module: given the Controller → Processor relationship, we typically route customers to Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) for the EU SCCs. If you have a legal preference for a different module, flag it now.
2) DPA: I’ve attached our standard DPA template (redwood-dpa-template-v2.pdf) — please share any company-level must-haves or redlines your legal team expects.
3) Security questionnaire: please find attached the Redwood vendor security questionnaire link in the Doc below — can you confirm who on your side will complete it? If helpful, we can run it in parallel with legal review to avoid blocking.
4) Next milestone: target signature window — 2–3 weeks from now if no major redlines. Please confirm if procurement timeline differs.

Attachments included: redwood-dpa-template-v2.pdf, redwood-security-questionnaire-link (Drive).

If it works, Ben (copied) will draft a short SCC recommendation and DPA note for your legal team today.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

--
Attachment stubs: redwood-dpa-template-v2.pdf (20 pages; DPA + SCC addendum), redwood-sq-link.txt (link to questionnaire)
From: Laura Sato <laura.sato@medistream.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps: DPA preference / SCC module / security SQ kickoff

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: MediStream will be Controller for the data sets we discussed (patient records + enrichment outputs). Redwood will be Processor for inference hosting and transient telemetry.
- SOC 2: we completed control testing and expect Type II report by end of Q4; I attached our current SOC 2 one-pager and existing security posture summary.
- HIPAA: yes, BAAs are required for any PHI processing — that’s critical for our procurement team.

Attaching: medistream-security-questionnaire.xlsx (we started filling it out), medistream-soc2-summary.pdf.

Legal / procurement POC: Marta Ruiz (marta.ruiz@medistream.io) — I’ll loop her into contract threads once you have a DPA + SCC recommendation. Our target is to complete legal review within 2 weeks of receiving the finalized DPA.

One question: on SCC modules — are there any implications if we remain Controller and Redwood is Processor but we need a narrow Processor sub-processor model (some inference performed in our VPC)? Happy to discuss specifics; for now, Module 2 sounds appropriate.

Laura
Laura Sato
Head of Platform Security, MediStream
laura.sato@medistream.io

--
Attachment stubs: medistream-security-questionnaire.xlsx (in progress), medistream-soc2-summary.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Sato <laura.sato@medistream.io>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps: DPA preference / SCC module / security SQ kickoff

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the questionnaire + SOC summary. Quick note from legal/solutions side to keep things moving: 

Recommendation (SCC + DPA):
- SCC Module: we agree Module 2 (Controller → Processor) is the right starting point given your role as Controller and Redwood as Processor for hosted inference. This covers the standard Controller-to-Processor clauses under the EU SCC framework.
- BAA: we will include a HIPAA/BAA addendum to the DPA to cover PHI processing.
- Sub-processing / VPC nuance: if MediStream intends to host any inference in your VPC (private deployment), we can include a narrow sub-processor clause and explicit routing rules in Section 4 of the DPA — please indicate the expected % of traffic or specific workloads to clarify scoping.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Redwood will circulate a DPA + SCC addendum with Module 2 pre-selected and BAA language inserted. (I’ll attach a redline; Stephanie will send the file to your legal POC.)
2) Complete your security questionnaire — we’ll treat the completed worksheet as the primary intake for SOC2/HIPAA evidence requests. For anything we need to validate, Redwood can provide control summaries and the current SOC2 artifacts when the Type II is available.
3) Signatures: we can run the DPA via DocuSign (link below) once you confirm legal POC and any must-have clauses.

DocuSign draft link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/RDW-4621
